legal_routes.name: Public43 accepted both-exit replay (historical; not fresh44)

steps.goal: Send the left parcel through the left return stop.
steps.action: Pac holds OPEN LEFT while Isp moves through the left-center to draw Cana's boomerang across left_sac. After it passes, Pac steps off the valve so the return can carry the parcel through the open stop.
steps.expected_feedback: The left parcel reaches the left cargo side and the left route remains available to Isp.
steps.observed_feedback: The historical trace shows the left parcel shifted to the left cargo edge, then Isp's KEEP LEFT latch active.

evidence.claim: At frame 259 the left_sac has moved to the left cargo edge; the left receiver is released after its hold interval.
At frame 392 ISP occupies KEEP LEFT and its latch is active after the first parcel cycle.

steps.goal: Latch the left route before the second cycle.
steps.action: Isp steps on KEEP LEFT; Pac stays on the right to serve the other side.
steps.expected_feedback: KEEP LEFT latches open for Isp's route.
steps.observed_feedback: KEEP LEFT is latched in the historical trace at frame 392.

evidence.claim: At frame 392 ISP occupies KEEP LEFT and its latch is active after the first parcel cycle.
At frame 409 ISP holds OPEN RIGHT while Pac remains on the right; the second parcel cycle begins.

steps.goal: Send the right parcel through the right return stop.
steps.action: Isp holds OPEN RIGHT at the left while Cana's nearest target is Pac on the right, drawing the return across right_sac. Isp steps off after the parcel passes; Pac then steps on KEEP RIGHT.
steps.expected_feedback: The right parcel reaches the right cargo side and KEEP RIGHT latches open for Pac.
steps.observed_feedback: The historical trace shows the right cargo side active, OPEN RIGHT released after the parcel moves right, and KEEP RIGHT latched by Pac.

evidence.claim: At frame 409 ISP holds OPEN RIGHT while Pac remains on the right; the second parcel cycle begins.
At frame 539 the right cargo pad is active and right_sac has crossed toward the right side.
At frame 586 OPEN RIGHT is released and right_sac is on the right perches after its return cycle.
At frame 748 Pac occupies KEEP RIGHT and its latch is active.

steps.action: Isp follows the left route to the Isp exit and Pac follows the right route to the Pac exit.
steps.observed_feedback: The historical public replay completes both exits with zero deaths; this is scripted feasibility evidence, not a human walkthrough.

confidence_reason: Current source and the public43 accepted route establish mechanics and one successful ordinary-input path. They do not measure human novice difficulty or prove route optimality; public43 is historical rather than fresh44 replay.

confirmed: The objective plainly requires both parcels and both exits.
The room depends on a causal relation between boomerang target and parcel delivery.
unresolved: Whether direct parcel pushing can replace the boomerang cycle while still opening both exits; source permits pushing but no accepted replay proves this shortcut.
Whether a human player reads the visible aiming/warning cues reliably; screenshots do not measure that.
missed_mechanics: The parcels are lightweight pushable crates; the receiver valves are temporary hold pads and KEEP pads latch route access.
Nearest-target selection is locked before projectile release, so players can steer the delivery by spacing.
incorrect_inferences: The first pass left the divider/platform crossings and delivery order uncertain; source defines continuous safe floor and pad-controlled stops.
changed_judgments: Execution 2→1 because a successful ordinary-input replay uses walking/waiting without a demonstrated precision-jump requirement.
Timing null→2 because source shows cooldown, windup, return path, and a hold receiver requirement.
Hazards null→0 and recovery null→1 because the mandatory route is hazard-free and missed cycles can be retried; no human failure was observed.
Clarity 3→2 because visible side labels/objective explain destinations, while the critical bait/receiver/KEEP cycle is not fully cued in idle screenshots.

single_operator_note: Baseline assumes two humans. The route uses separate Isp/Pac input channels, but no single-operator trial was performed; this record makes no claim about one-person demand.
